topic: Exact interactive request-to-effect provenance prerequisite for safe response replay

measured_parent_gap.finding: Two distinct V16 requests in one execution both match the current V17 execution-generation ancestry for one effect; current durable state has no exact request_key_hash-to-effect_id edge even though the effect reaches DONE_VALID.

candidate_components.role: Trusted ingress wrapper mints a sealed process-local request capability only for a newly durable ADMITTED request on a live execution; durable REPLAY receives no new effect authority.
candidate_components.authority: Capability revalidates exact V16 request row plus live physical lease, execution, epoch, credential, session and client on every use.

candidate_components.role: Persists immutable exact request_key_hash <-> effect_id ancestry after reservation and before ATTEMPT_STARTED; combines request capability with existing ExecutionGenerationFence.
candidate_components.scope: Interactive direct-token effects only; autonomous/internal effects retain separate provenance paths.

candidate_components.role: Ordinary positive/negative provenance and authority repair gate.
Scoped self-hosted Linux/X64 target gate behind V2-admitted private SQLite 3.53.4.

required_target_falsifiers_before_suppor: request A and request B are both newly admitted in the same execution and receive distinct live request capabilities
durable replay of request A receives no newly minted request capability
direct construction of a request capability without trusted seal is denied
one effect is immutably bound to request A before ATTEMPT_STARTED
request B in the same execution cannot rebind or begin request A's effect
request A can begin exactly one ATTEMPT_STARTED and the effect can still reach V17 DONE_VALID
execution-generation-only ancestry still observes both requests while exact request-effect binding observes exactly one
after execution release request A's old request capability is dead
a new execution/request cannot reuse the old request-effect binding
integrity_check is ok and foreign_key_check is empty
no external effect, no canonical database mutation, no second GO OOB

response_replay_gate.reason: Do not add replayable result/response receipts until exact request-effect ancestry itself has an accepted target receipt.
response_replay_gate.future_invariant: A replay receipt may consume exact request-effect ancestry plus verified effect outcome and V17 terminal truth, but must never create effect truth or provider authority.
response_replay_gate.crash_semantics: If no response/result receipt existed before a crash, do not invent historical response bytes. Expose a typed recovered verified outcome or no-response-receipt state instead.
